MONKEY SAFETY NETS

High-gauge, tear-resistant safety nets designed to prevent aggressive monkey troops from entering balconies and terraces.

Direct Starting Rate: ₹35 / sq.ft
Durability Warranty: 3-Year Anti-Tear Guarantee

Residential areas adjacent to hills, forests, or parks frequently suffer aggressive monkey troops raiding balconies, destroying plants, and endangering family members. Standard pigeon nets can be easily shredded by monkey teeth and claws. Invisible Safety Monkey Safety Nets utilize extra-thick 2.5mm+ braided virgin polymer ropes anchored with heavy stainless steel perimeter wire rope and turnbuckles that monkeys cannot chew or tear through.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION TABLE
Mesh Thickness 2.5 mm to 3.0 mm Extra-Heavy Braided HDPE Polymer
Tensile Strength 200+ kgf Breaking Strength (Primate-proof)
Mesh Aperture 40 mm x 40 mm (Blocks limbs and head entry)
Perimeter Anchors 4.0 mm Galvanized Wire Rope with Heavy-Duty Turnbuckles
Warranty 3-Year Full Replacement Anti-Tear Warranty
